comment: The toolchains that no other file of the checkout declares (T19.2). php lists the PHP minor version that the suite runs on, the pin of kit: setup-php installs the latest patch of a minor and cannot pin a patch, so the minor is the pin and each CI run records the patch it ran on in its report. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs (Go, Python with uv, ruff, vulture, alint, golangci-lint, deadcode, govulncheck, cargo-audit and Composer) and mise.lock locks them for every platform of the bootstrap (T24.12). symbolExtractors and the Rust nightly of exceptions are the symbol extractors of the parity check (config/parity.json, T22.6-14).

exceptions.reason: the rust symbol extractor of the parity check reads the rustdoc JSON of the crate, which only a nightly writes (rust-lang/rust#76578)
